xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4402: Desktop app: open a chosen machine's dashboard with no local server

plan.title: Desktop app: open a chosen machine's dashboard with no local server
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The desktop app always spawns its embedded dashboard server and can only show this computer's dashboard. The Anywhere epic (W-PHONE3, D-14) needs the desktop app to open one chosen other machine's dashboard, for example the desktop over Tailscale, with no local server running and with that machine's device credential stored only through Electron safeStorage.
narratives.Proposal: Pair from a pairing link in the Electron main process (POST /api/pairing/exchange with delivery 'bearer' and an Origin header), store one machine record in <userData>/remote-machine.json with the odk_ token encrypted by safeStorage, and at launch run a preflight (transport policy, descriptor environmentId and protocolVersion, session mint). On success skip startServer and load the machine's own origin in an in-memory partition 'remote-<environmentId>' with the overdeck_device cookie set by the main process, so the unchanged frontend works as a paired browser. A small local connect window handles pairing, errors, Use This Computer and Forget; menu, tray and main-process calls follow the active machine. Full design: .pan/drafts/pan-4402.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No machine catalog, list of several machines or environment switcher (PAN-4645, W-LINK1)
- No Settings → Connections page or Devices panel in the desktop app
- No version or capability gating beyond protocolVersion === 1 (W-LINK3, W-LINK7)
- No Tailscale install or setup, relay, directory, Noise secure channel or key pinning
- No change to src/dashboard/ or src/lib/ (server and frontend unchanged)
- No fix for the pre-existing /api/agents/emergency-stop menu path
- No persistent remote partition and no Set-Cookie rewriting
- No silent fallback to local mode when the chosen machine is unreachable
- No plaintext device token on disk, in desktop-settings.json, in any renderer, or in logs

autoDecisions.summary: The remote page authenticates with the overdeck_device cookie set by the main process in an in-memory partition (no persist: prefix).
autoDecisions.rationale: Cookies are what the frontend and every /ws/* upgrade already accept, so no frontend change is needed; Electron 40 has no cookie-encryption fuse configured, so an in-memory partition is the only way to keep a plaintext copy off disk. Bearer injection through webRequest is unverified for WebSocket upgrades.

autoDecisions.summary: safeStorage is mandatory: refuse to pair when encryption is unavailable or the Linux backend is basic_text/unknown.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires the credential to be stored with safeStorage, and the basic_text backend uses a hard-coded key, which is plaintext-equivalent.

autoDecisions.summary: Transport policy: https any host; http only for loopback and Tailscale addresses (100.64.0.0/10, fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48, *.ts.net, or names resolving only to those).
autoDecisions.rationale: Epic revision 3 forbids unencrypted traffic between machines; the done-when is over Tailscale; loopback keeps SSH forwards and local UAT possible.

autoDecisions.summary: An unreachable, revoked or changed machine at launch opens the connect window with the reason; the app never silently starts the local server.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator chose not to run a server on this computer; a silent fallback would start one behind their back.

autoDecisions.summary: Docs are updated (docs/DESKTOP-APP.md, configuration/remote-access.mdx) although the issue body says 'Docs: None'.
autoDecisions.rationale: The repo PRD rule requires a docs work item for new behavior, and remote-access.mdx currently describes PAN-4402 as an environment switcher, which D-14 made wrong.

autoDecisions.summary: At most one machine record; pairing a new machine replaces it after a best-effort self-revoke of the old device.
autoDecisions.rationale: D-14 says the desktop app connects to one machine; the catalog belongs to PAN-4645.

items.title: Add machine-url.ts: pairing-link parser and transport policy

verify_commands: cd apps/desktop && npx vitest run --configLoader runner tests/machine-url.test.ts

narrative.Action: Create the pure module apps/desktop/src/machine-url.ts exactly as PRD W-1 specifies: parsePairingLink(input) reduces a `<base>/#pair=odp_…` link to { baseUrl: URL.origin, credential } and refuses bare credentials and non-links with the PRD messages; assessMachineTransport(baseUrl, lookupAll) applies D-5 (https any host; http only for loopback, 100.64.0.0/10, fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48, *.ts.net, or names whose injected DNS lookup returns only such addresses) and refuses everything else with the FR-3 text; export isTailnetAddress and isLoopbackAddress. No Electron import. Add tests/machine-url.test.ts with every case listed in PRD W-1.

items.title: Given `http://192.168.1.5:3011`, assessMachineTransport returns ok:false with the FR-3 sentence starting 'Overdeck sends this computer's credential only over HTTPS, Tailscale or this computer's loopback'
Given `http://100.64.0.1` or `http://desk:3011` with a lookup returning ['100.90.1.2'], assessMachineTransport returns ok:true kind 'tailnet'; with lookup ['100.90.1.2','192.168.1.5'] it refuses

Given `https://desk.tail1234.ts.net/foo/#pair=odp_abc`, parsePairingLink returns baseUrl 'https://desk.tail1234.ts.net' and credential 'odp_abc'; given bare 'odp_abc' it returns the 'Paste the whole pairing link' error
Given `http://100.128.0.1`, assessMachineTransport refuses it (outside 100.64.0.0/10) and `http://127.0.0.1:3911` returns kind 'loopback'
Add machine-store.ts: safeStorage-encrypted machine record

verify_commands: cd apps/desktop && npx vitest run --configLoader runner tests/machine-store.test.ts

narrative.Action: Create apps/desktop/src/machine-store.ts per PRD W-2: MachineRecord type, credentialStoreStatus() implementing D-4 (refuse when safeStorage.isEncryptionAvailable() is false, and on Linux when getSelectedStorageBackend() is basic_text or unknown), loadMachineRecord, saveMachineRecord (token encrypted with safeStorage.encryptString, base64 in tokenCiphertext, atomic temp-file + rename with mode 0o600 at <userData>/remote-machine.json), setMachineActive, readMachineToken, deleteMachineRecord. Add tests/machine-store.test.ts with a temp userData dir and a reversible safeStorage fake.

items.title: Given a saved record, the file <userData>/remote-machine.json does not contain the plaintext token, and loadMachineRecord plus readMachineToken returns the original token
When safeStorage.isEncryptionAvailable() returns false, or on Linux the backend is 'basic_text', saveMachineRecord throws the FR-5 'no secure credential store' message and writes no file
Given a malformed remote-machine.json, loadMachineRecord returns null without throwing
On non-Windows platforms saveMachineRecord creates the file with mode 0o600, asserted with a plain if-branch rather than skipIf
Add machine-client.ts: pairing exchange, launch preflight, self-revoke

verify_commands: cd apps/desktop && npx vitest run --configLoader runner tests/machine-client.test.ts

narrative.Action: Create apps/desktop/src/machine-client.ts per PRD W-3 with injected fetchImpl and lookupAll: fetchMachineDescriptor, pairWithMachine (parse link, check credential store, check transport, read descriptor, POST /api/pairing/exchange with Origin header equal to the base origin, delivery 'bearer' and label 'Overdeck desktop on <hostname>', verify environmentId and odk_ token, best-effort revoke an older record, save the new active record), preflightMachine (transport, descriptor id and protocolVersion 1, decrypt token, POST /api/dashboard/session with bearer; map failures to the reasons and FR-5 messages), and revokeOwnDevice (session mint for csrfToken, then DELETE /api/devices/:id with bearer, JSON content type and x-overdeck-csrf-token). Add tests/machine-client.test.ts.

items.title: When pairWithMachine runs, the exchange request sends header Origin equal to the base origin and a JSON body with delivery 'bearer' and a label starting 'Overdeck desktop on '

Given an exchange 401 response, pairWithMachine returns 'Pairing failed: unknown or already used pairing credential' and saves no record; given a 403 'Invalid origin' it appends the trusted-addresses hint
Given an unavailable credential store, pairWithMachine returns the store error and sends no fetch request (the credential is not spent)
preflightMachine returns reason 'revoked' for a session-mint 401, 'wrong-machine' for a descriptor environmentId mismatch, 'unreachable' for a rejected fetch, and ok with the token for a 200
revokeOwnDevice sends the x-overdeck-csrf-token header taken from the session-mint response and returns false when the mint rejects
Add connection.ts: active dashboard state, dashboardFetch, in-memory device-cookie session

verify_commands: cd apps/desktop && npx vitest run --configLoader runner tests/connection.test.ts

narrative.Action: Create apps/desktop/src/connection.ts per PRD W-4: the ActiveDashboard union (local with baseUrl, remote with baseUrl, partition, label, token), getters and setters, remotePartitionName(environmentId) returning 'remote-<id>' with no persist: prefix, dashboardFetch(path, init) that prefixes the active base URL and adds Authorization Bearer in remote mode, prepareRemoteSession that sets the overdeck_device cookie (httpOnly, sameSite strict, secure only for https) on session.fromPartition and throws if the partition starts with persist:, and isSameOrigin. Add tests/connection.test.ts with Electron session mocked.

items.title: In remote mode dashboardFetch('/api/health') sends the request to the remote base URL with header Authorization 'Bearer odk_…'; in local mode it sends to the local URL with no Authorization header
Given an empty local base URL, dashboardFetch rejects instead of sending a relative request
prepareRemoteSession sends one cookies.set call with name 'overdeck_device', httpOnly true, sameSite 'strict', secure false for an http base and true for an https base
remotePartitionName returns a name without the 'persist:' prefix, and prepareRemoteSession throws when given a persist: partition
Add the connect window: connect.html, connect-preload, sender-checked IPC

verify_commands: cd apps/desktop && npx vitest run --configLoader runner tests/connect-window.test.ts
cd apps/desktop && bun run build && test -f dist-electron/connect-preload.js

narrative.Action: Create the connect window per PRD W-5: static resources/connect.html with inline CSS/JS and a strict CSP, showing the saved machine (Open, Use this computer, Forget), a pairing-link field with Connect, an error area and the 'Create the link on that machine' hint; src/connect-preload.ts exposing window.overdeckConnect over five fixed pan:connect-* channels; src/connect-window.ts with openConnectWindow(error?) (single window, sandbox true) and registerConnectIpc(handlers) whose handlers reject any event.sender other than the connect window. Add the connect-preload entry to tsdown.config.ts. Do not edit main.ts in this item.

items.title: When a pan:connect-* handler is invoked from a webContents other than the connect window, it returns { ok: false, error: 'not allowed' } and the injected handler is not called
The pan:connect-get-state response contains mode, machine label/baseUrl and error, and contains no token or tokenCiphertext key
Calling openConnectWindow twice creates one BrowserWindow and focuses it the second time
`bun run build` produces dist-electron/connect-preload.js alongside main.js and preload.js
Wire remote mode into main.ts: boot plan, no embedded server, window partitions, switching

verify_commands: cd apps/desktop && npx vitest run --configLoader runner tests/boot.test.ts

narrative.Action: Implement PRD W-6: add pure apps/desktop/src/boot.ts planBoot(record, isDevelopment); in main.ts extract onLocalServerReady, call startServer only for a local plan, add openRemoteDashboard(record) running preflightMachine then setRemoteDashboard, prepareRemoteSession and window recreation (or openConnectWindow with the FR-5 error, never a server start), make resolveWindowUrl, createWindow and createTerminalWindow use the remote base URL and partition plus the D-9 navigation guard, make RESTART_DASHBOARD throw the FR-7 message in remote mode, route callServerApi through dashboardFetch, wire registerConnectIpc handlers (pair stops the embedded server then opens remote; useLocal clears active and starts the server; forget revokes, deletes and returns to local), and export openConnectWindowFromMenu and useThisComputer.

items.title: planBoot returns local for a null record, an inactive record, or development mode, and returns remote for an active record outside development mode

Given an active record, the ready handler calls openRemoteDashboard and does not call startServer; every startServer call in main.ts sits in the local boot branch, the RESTART_DASHBOARD handler, or the use-this-computer path
When preflight fails at launch, the app opens the connect window with the FR-5 message and does not start the embedded server
In remote mode the RESTART_DASHBOARD IPC rejects with 'This window shows <label>. Restart its dashboard on that machine.'

In remote mode the app creates main and terminal windows with webPreferences.partition 'remote-<environmentId>', and will-navigate to another origin is prevented and routes the URL to shell.openExternal
Make the menu and tray follow the active machine and offer Connect / Use This Computer

verify_commands: cd apps/desktop && npx vitest run --configLoader runner tests/menu.test.ts

narrative.Action: Implement PRD W-7: replace the serverUrl imports in menu.ts and tray.ts with dashboardFetch/getActiveDashboard from connection.ts; fetchActiveWorkspaces and refreshTrayStatus use dashboardFetch; add 'Connect to a Machine…' and 'Use This Computer' (enabled only in remote mode) to the Overdeck menu and the tray context menu; show 'Showing <label>' and the tray tooltip 'Overdeck — <label>' in remote mode; export refreshApplicationMenu() and call it from main.ts after every mode switch. Update tests/menu.test.ts mocks and add the new menu assertions.

items.title: The built Overdeck submenu contains an item labelled 'Connect to a Machine…' that calls openConnectWindowFromMenu when clicked
In local mode the 'Use This Computer' item is rendered with enabled false; in remote mode it is enabled and the submenu shows 'Showing <label>'
After this item, `grep -n serverUrl apps/desktop/src/menu.ts apps/desktop/src/tray.ts` prints nothing
In remote mode tray health polling sends GET <remote base>/api/health through dashboardFetch with the bearer header
Run the end-to-end remote-mode check and record it in the PRD verification log

expected_outputs: the PRD contains a Verification log section

narrative.Action: Follow PRD W-8 exactly: build the desktop app, start a second Overdeck server with its own OVERDECK_HOME on port 3911, pair it with `pan pair --url http://127.0.0.1:3911 --json`, launch the desktop app with an isolated --user-data-dir under DISPLAY=:1, connect with the link, then check the window origin, that no server.js child runs under the Electron process, that no odk_ string exists under the profile directory, that a relaunch reopens the machine, and that revoking the device shows the FR-5 revoked message. Append the outputs under '## Verification log' at the end of .pan/drafts/pan-4402.md and repeat them in the PR description; with no display, record 'E2E not run: no display' instead.

The verification log records that `grep -r odk_ <profile dir>` returns no match after pairing and one relaunch
